method: Every live fact was read as one block (claim, displays, scope, quotes); duplicate candidates came from shared quote sentences and claim-token similarity (reg_analyze.py, reg-analysis.txt). Decisions are in reg-decisions.json; patches in reg-patches/ (built by reg_build.py, which checks every display of every live fact: held by a normalised quote and at most 8 words when it has no digit); applied through saa.py by reg_apply.py (log reg-apply.log.jsonl). Demand statuses written by reg_demand.py. New facts: facts-register-01.json.
rules_applied: Duplicates: superseded when two facts quote the same sentence or state the same rule from pages of the same kind, and composites that repeat facts of their own; FAQ facts that repeat a guide sentence were kept for the FAQ quick-fire, pricing-page copies of FAQ answers were merged into the FAQ fact.
Displays without a digit: a verbatim phrase of at most 8 words from one quote (RULINGS 2026-10-11); 363 long or claim-only displays were shortened, 9 dropped, 1 added.

Claims cut to their evidence: ecr-archive-storage-class-rarely-accessed (evidence reduced to the archive sentence), ecr-faq-regional-service, eks-cost-monitoring-split-cost-allocation, eks-hybrid-nodes-network-connectivity-options, fargate-compute-savings-plans-cover-fargate-lambda, fargate-limited-linux-capabilities, ecs-managed-instances-privileged-capabilities-allowed.

Relevance raised to core where a kept fact absorbed a core duplicate: ecs-maximum-percent-meaning, ecs-minimum-healthy-percent-meaning, eks-hybrid-nodes-pricing-vcpu-hour; eks-anywhere-faq-enterprise-subscription-prerequisite to extended.

Namespace: ecs-pricing-fargate-vcpu-memory-storage-per-second merged into the fargate fact of the same quote (Fargate billing lives in fargate); all other facts sit in the namespace of the service they describe.

Notes corrected: ecs-change-service-connect-ga-2022-11 and eks-change-app-mesh-existing-customers-only-2023-09 now point to the App Mesh end-of-support fact; ecs-faq-mi-instance-refresh-14-days carries the 14 versus 21 days source conflict.

rejected.ecs-faq-cloudwatch-metrics-kept-two-week: older FAQ wording about CloudWatch metric retention, a CloudWatch property; not taught here
